scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You hold your phone near the card machine, and it beeps. Paid. But your real card number never left your phone. How?

scenes.name: nfc
scenes.text: Your phone and the machine talk using NFC, a radio link that only works within a few centimetres.

scenes.name: token
scenes.text: When you add your card, the card network gives your phone a token, a stand in number. Your real card number isn't stored on the phone.

scenes.name: unlock
scenes.text: You confirm with your fingerprint, face or PIN, so a thief can't simply tap your phone.

scenes.name: code
scenes.text: For each payment, the phone creates a one time code. Copy it, and it's useless for the next payment.

scenes.name: swap
scenes.text: The card network swaps the token back for your real card details, and your bank approves it as usual.

scenes.name: safe
scenes.text: Even if a shop's system leaked, the token alone can't be used elsewhere. That's why card tokenisation is required by RBI rules in India.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Tap, token, unlock, approve. Your card stays secret. Follow for more on how things really work.
